title: MeshyCal Scheduling Proposal v1
description: Candidate meeting time slots proposed by one MeshyCal scheduling agent to another. Phase 3 adds additive optional fields (calendar_titles, attendee_emails, constraint_hints) per ARCH §8.5 — these are present in a sender's internal payload but stripped by the sender's user-signed policy before crossing the wire.

candidates.description: Proposed meeting start times in UTC (ISO 8601). Ordered by sender preference.

duration_minutes.description: Desired meeting duration in whole minutes.

calendar_titles.description: (Phase 3) Sender's own calendar entry titles for context. ALWAYS blocked outbound by the default MeshyCal policy; present here only so internal agents can carry it through their own scoping check.

attendee_emails.description: (Phase 3) Email addresses of the sender's existing attendees. ALWAYS blocked outbound by the default MeshyCal policy.

constraint_hints.description: (Phase 3) Soft scheduling constraints the sender is willing to share. Allowed outbound by the default MeshyCal policy.
